entries.heading: RIGHTS OF THE VICTIM OF A SEXUAL ASSAULT
ancestors: DIVISION C—DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY NATIONAL SECURITY AUTHORIZATIONS AND OTHER AUTHORIZATIONS
entries.text:
SEC. 3543. RIGHTS OF THE VICTIM OF A 
                          SEXUAL ASSAULT.

    A victim of a sexual assault covered by the comprehensive policy 
developed under section 3542(a) has the right to be reasonably protected 
from the accused.
